# Namma Web LLP — Namma Web Advanced AI Research Labs
> Karnataka's 1st Sovereign AI company & India's 1st offline Sovereign AI pioneer (Bengaluru).
> Official Winner of Idea2PoC – ELEVATE SHAKTI 2026 (Government of Karnataka — INR 40 Lakhs Grant-in-Aid).

## Key facts
- World's 1st 100% offline AI model implemented in schools (Government, Aided & Private), DPDP Act 2023 & POCSO compliant — "Saraswathi AI™".
- Shakthi AI™ (Shakthi Swasthya / Shiksha / Suraksha) powers Anemia Mukt Karnataka & Bharat via CSR & DMF collaborations.
- Founders: P. Dakshayani (Women Director & Majority Co-Founder, 51% Partner) & Mallikarjun S Nandyal (Founder, Director, CEO & Chief AI Architect, Ex-BEL).
- Products & Programs: Custom offline school LLM modules, Agentic AI / Generative AI / AI Marketing / FinTech AI Fellowships, K-12 Composite AI Courses, College CoE & Placement Cell, AI Research Internship.
- Careers: hr.recruitment.nammaweb@outlook.in | General & Institutional: info@nammaweb.com | Phone: +91-9241527429.
- Locations: Nagasandra & Peenya (Bengaluru 560073 / 560057), Kengeri (Bengaluru), Nelamangala (562123, next to Harsha International Public School).
